summary: Configured and validated daily rotation of app.log with seven immediately compressed archives and copytruncate write continuity. node1 was rebooted exactly once; its boot ID changed and the policy, timer, archives, and write path recovered successfully.
actions_performed: Installed /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app with daily, rotate 7, compress, missingok, notifempty, and copytruncate.
Performed a real forced rotation while holding the log open and verified continued writing through the same descriptor.
Verified successful execution through logrotate.service and the enabled daily timer.
Restarted node1 once and verified persistence and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Rotate app.log daily and keep seven compressed rotations
evidence.summary: The installed and post-reboot parsed policy reports daily rotation and seven rotations; the forced test produced a valid app.log.1.gz archive.

evidence.requirement: Allow the application to continue writing after rotation
evidence.summary: The active log retained inode 2284 across rotation, and a write through the already-open descriptor succeeded afterward.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 24163185-f2ac-4d25-822d-ce9bfa7178bc, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 6e831aa7-a507-4ec1-a511-8b715eb1c02c, and recovered timer, policy checksum, service result, archived data, and post-restart write.
